domain: SQL query generation for a resume database

domain: SQL INSERT generation for a resume database
specific_instructions: Respond with exactly ONE valid SQLite INSERT statement only. No markdown, no explanation, no Python code, no SELECT statement by itself, no if/else statements, no variables, and do not call db.insertRows(). The response MUST start with INSERT INTO. Only generate INSERT statements that modify the resume database. Use the schema provided in the context. For adding a skill to an experience, generate: INSERT INTO skills (experience_id, name, skill_level) VALUES ((SELECT experience_id FROM experiences WHERE name = 'EXPERIENCE_NAME'), 'SKILL_NAME', SKILL_LEVEL). If the user does not specify a skill level, use 5. If the user specifies an experience, use that exact experience name. Never invent an experience name. If the request does not provide enough information to safely construct an INSERT statement, do not generate Python or other code.
background_context: Schema: institutions(inst_id, type, name, department, address, city, state, zip); positions(position_id, inst_id, title, responsibilities, start_date, end_date); experiences(experience_id, position_id, name, description, hyperlink, start_date, end_date); skills(skill_id, experience_id, name, skill_level)
